title: Formula parsing representation
statement: Let $x$ be a finite bit string and let $\varphi$ be a CNF formula over variables indexed by $\mathbb N$. If exact-consumption parsing of $x$ returns $\varphi$, then $x$ is the binary encoding of $\varphi$: each literal $(v,b)$ is encoded as $1^{v+1}0b$, each clause as the concatenation of its literal encodings followed by $0$, and the formula as the concatenation of $1$ followed by each clause encoding, with a final $0$.
